critical_code_review_comments: Meta: agent-orchestration bug — review_request payloads exceeding ~6KB are being silently truncated before reaching T1, which is unsafe for production-scoped tasks. Recommend upstream fix to either chunk the payload or reject the invocation when truncation is detected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Do not proceed unless the full review_request is re-supplied. Any production test must be strictly scoped, non-destructive, and the founder password must never appear in chat/logs/curl examples/files (see /app/memory/test_credentials.md security policy — password was rotated once already after prior leak). Preview credentials (test@aurem.dev / AuremTest2026!) are safe for arbitrary dev testing on https://bin-context-pat.preview.emergentagent.com if the task can be validated there instead.
rca of the issue: Root cause: the review_request the main agent forwarded to this T1 sub-agent was truncated by 5764 chars, leaving only a security-policy epilogue with no actionable test target. Mitigation: main agent must re-send the full request; if the payload is too large, split it into a short 'task' summary + attached spec file path (e.g. /app/memory/<spec>.md) that T1 can view_file.
